layers.message: Add API key issuing, rotation, and bearer authentication
Record project context for credential rotation

graderOnly: Documentation of the rotation procedure (AC-002) is owned by the later DOCUMENTING phase, and no foundational or cross-cutting redesign is requested. Either FEATURE (a bounded capability) or EVOLUTION (zero-downtime rotation changes the existing immediate-replacement rotation, a transition concern) is a fitting single mode.

The existing CredentialStore.rotate() in src/credentials.js deletes the current key's hash before storing the new one, so rotation today invalidates the old key immediately; that is the behavior AC-001 changes.
docs/operations.md currently describes only the immediate-replacement rotation; it has no zero-downtime procedure.

No blocking architecture question is needed: the scope fixes that rotation is user-initiated, the old key works until the user finishes the rotation, there is no automatic expiry, and the header and key format stay the same.

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 50-project (pre-install): plain-JS Node project 'dispatch' with CredentialStore (one key per account, SHA-256 hashed, rotate() replaces the key at once), bearer authenticate(), handlers createKey/rotateKey/getAccount, node:test suites, and docs/operations.md (the project-facing operations guide, with no zero-downtime rotation procedure). 60-context: Auditor-style .standards/CONTEXT.md for the cycle and STATE at SCOPING after a FORWARD from AUDITING. 70-scope: scope record with AC-001 (rotation without downtime, with the finish-rotation semantics stated in the condition) and AC-002 (operations guide documents the procedure before sign-off), STATE at ARCHITECTING / STANDARD / Architecture NONE / recovery inactive, FORWARD from SCOPING. Documentation ownership and mode choice are not stated anywhere in the repo; they come from the protocol and skill. No existing design document exists, so the Architect creates the design at the fixed path via artifact init.
